lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple high-intensity circular pixel clusters organized into approximately four identifiable vertical columns posterior to the gill slits, with highest-intensity nodes concentrated in the mid-lateral region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated luminance intersecting with circular spots, creating a grid-like matrix where vertical stripes and horizontal alignments meet at high-intensity nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A single prominent horizontal ridge is visible in the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with higher intensity on the dorsal side and shadowing on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly irregular, non-circular luminance patterns (vermiculated or 'maze' markings) located in the transitional zone between the gills and the structured lateral grid.
